hero.subtitle: From a novel to the finished cut: episode planning, character design, storyboards, first frames, video generation, and the final composite. The mainline walks the pipeline step by step, while the canvas arranges the same work as a node graph — both share one set of assets. The desktop client takes over local media, long renders, and auto-updates.
hero.note: Installers come straight from the CDN and update themselves — install once and you're done.
hero.history: Past releases for every platform are on

preview.title: A guided pipeline and a free-form canvas
preview.lede: The mainline breaks a novel into episodes, characters, storyboards, first frames, video, and the final cut, one page per step. The canvas projects any of those shots onto a node graph where you can rework them freely and sync the result back. Both sides read from the same assets.
preview.alt: Esboço do Canvas TG Criativo: abas de criativos no topo, estrutura de cenas à esquerda, nós no centro e parâmetros à direita.
preview.caption: Illustration (canvas view)

capability.title: Four things only the desktop app does
capability.lede: Everything the web version runs, the app runs too. These four come with installing it.

localFiles.title: Drag local files onto the canvas
localFiles.description: Video, images and audio drop straight in from Finder or File Explorer using their local path — no upload round trip first.

longTasks.title: Long renders survive your browser
longTasks.description: Full-episode renders and batch first frames run for tens of minutes inside the app, so a closed tab can't throw the work away.

autoUpdate.title: Install once, stay current
autoUpdate.description: New versions download in the background and apply on next launch — you never come back for another installer.

localExport.title: Exports land on your own disk
localExport.description: Shot boards, first frames and finished cuts are filed into local folders per episode instead of piling up in a browser download list.

v132.title: Simpler local ComfyUI setup, consistent video modes
v132.description: MiniMax H3 covers several workflows through one model entry, and canvas modes such as first-frame stay consistent across validation, billing, and execution.

v131.title: Updatable official media catalog
v131.description: Settings can check the official media model catalog manually or automatically; image and video model options refresh as soon as a new catalog takes effect.

v130.title: Model channels and capabilities served from the backend
v130.description: Image and video models, parameters, and reference limits now come from backend configuration. MiniMax-H3 ships with the official preset, and a local ComfyUI can take over generation.

v121.title: More reliable media parameters and import progress
v121.description: Video ratio, resolution, and model-specific parameters are passed through intact with corrected 2K/4K sizing, and novel import shows stage, percentage, and elapsed time throughout.

v120.title: Transparent feature credits, external agents welcome
v120.description: Preços de recursos, estimativas e histórico de uso ficam em um só lugar; agentes locais podem operar o TG Criativo pelo MCP.

macGatekeeper.question: macOS says the developer cannot be verified. Now what?
macGatekeeper.answer: No Finder, abra Aplicativos, clique com Control no app TG Criativo, escolha Abrir e confirme. Isso só é necessário no primeiro uso.

winSmartScreen.question: Windows says it protected my PC. Now what?
winSmartScreen.answer: Click More info, then Run anyway. SmartScreen blocks installers by default until they have enough downloads; it says nothing about whether this one is intact.

offline.question: Does the app still need an internet connection?
offline.answer: Yes. Script generation, first-frame rendering and video assembly all run on cloud compute; the app handles orchestration, media management and writing results to disk. Cuts already downloaded stay playable offline.

update.question: How do I upgrade?
update.answer: You don't have to. The app checks on launch, downloads new versions in the background and applies them next time it starts. To install a specific version by hand, see

storage.question: Where do projects and exports live?
storage.answer: Project data lives in the cloud with your account, so every device signed in sees the same episodes. Exported boards, first frames and finished cuts are written to local disk, and you can change that path in settings.

openSource.question: Is it open source?
openSource.answer: It is licensed under Elastic-2.0: use, modify and self-host freely, but don't resell it as a hosted service. The source lives at

novelFormat.title: Premium drama format
novelFormat.intro: Roteiros comerciais precisam de limites claros entre criativos e cenas. O TG Criativo organiza o texto antes de gerar imagem, fala e áudio; não inventa cenas quando faltam marcações.
novelFormat.standardStatusHint: Several industry formats are supported. Complete location, time, and INT/EXT metadata can be parsed reliably.
novelFormat.warningStatusHint: Scene boundaries are clear, but location, time, or INT/EXT metadata is incomplete and will be normalized.
novelFormat.blockingStatusHint: Import is blocked only when chapters are invalid or a premium drama has no recognizable scene headings.
novelFormat.repairableHint: The scene boundary below is recognizable but its time is missing. Import is allowed with a warning; the source is unchanged.
novelFormat.ruleEpisode: Start every episode with “Episode N”; list multiple episodes in order.
novelFormat.ruleScene: Give every scene its own header. Supported forms include “1-1 Location Day INT”, “1.1 Location INT Day”, split fields, and INT./EXT. headings.
novelFormat.ruleCharacters: Use “Characters:” for names of characters physically present in the scene, separated by commas; keep identity and performance notes out of this line.
novelFormat.ruleBody: Keep one visible action or shot per line; both “△” and “▲” action markers are supported. Do not combine several shots or speakers on one line.
novelFormat.ruleDialogue: Write dialogue as “Character: line”. Add a short performance cue in parentheses only when needed, and use “Character OS: line” for inner voice.
novelFormat.ruleLocationChange: Create a new scene header when the physical location changes. Both Location-Time-INT/EXT and Location-INT/EXT-Time orders are supported.

sceneHeaders.missing: No scene headings were recognized, so the system cannot tell where each scene begins.
sceneHeaders.missingFix: Follow the example above: start with “Episode N”, then give every scene a separate “scene number, location, time, INT/EXT” heading before its characters, actions, and dialogue.
sceneHeaders.repairable: Scene boundaries were recognized, but some headings are missing a time, location, or INT/EXT value. Import is still allowed and the missing metadata will be completed during scene planning.
sceneHeaders.repairableFix: Use the example above to add the missing location, time, or INT/EXT value. You can also continue importing without editing the source.

nodeToolbar.multiDimensionPrompt: Generate multi-angle views of the same subject (front, 3/4 side, profile, back) while keeping style, lighting, and materials consistent.
nodeToolbar.relightPrompt: Keep the composition and subject unchanged; redesign the lighting only — adjust direction, color temperature, and contrast for a more cinematic look.
nodeToolbar.hdPrompt: Upscale this image to high definition: sharpen details and textures, remove noise and compression artifacts, while preserving the original composition, palette, and subject features.
nodeToolbar.outpaintPrompt: Naturally extend the canvas outward (outpainting): fill in plausible surroundings, lighting, and background while keeping the original subject, style, and atmosphere consistent.
nodeToolbar.repaintPrompt: Keep the subject and composition; repaint the image overall to improve quality and consistency, while preserving subject features, palette, and style.
nodeToolbar.erasePrompt: Erase distracting or unwanted elements from the image (clutter, text, watermarks) and seamlessly inpaint the occluded regions, keeping subject and background style consistent.
nodeToolbar.mattingPrompt: Cut out the subject and replace the background with a clean transparent (or solid) backdrop, preserving fine edge details (hair strands, semi-transparent regions) realistically.
nodeToolbar.noDownloadPresetPathsHint: No quick-save folder. Use default download.

gridMenu.multiCameraGridPrompt: From this image, generate a 3x3 grid of multi-camera views covering front, left/right 3/4, profiles, back, and varied tilt angles, keeping the subject, style, lighting, and materials fully consistent.
gridMenu.plotFourGridPrompt: From this image, project the next plot beats and generate a 2x2 grid of consecutive frames within the same scene, preserving character design, spatial relationships, lighting, and overall style.
gridMenu.faceThreeViewPrompt: From this character face, generate front, 3/4, and full profile three-view sheets, keeping hairstyle, facial proportions, skin tone, gaze, and expression style consistent on a clean neutral background.
gridMenu.productThreeViewPrompt: From this product, generate front, side, and top three-view sheets, keeping materials, colors, proportions, and details accurate on a clean neutral background suitable for product display.
gridMenu.serialStoryboard25Prompt: From this image, generate a coherent 25-cell storyboard covering a full narrative beat (setup-development-climax-resolution), keeping character design, scene setting, shot style, and atmosphere consistent.
gridMenu.cinematicLightCorrectionPrompt: Apply cinematic light grading: refine key/fill light relationship, adjust color temperature, contrast, and highlight/shadow layering for added volume and cinematic feel, while keeping subject and composition unchanged.
gridMenu.characterThreeViewPrompt: From this character, generate front, side, and back full-body three-view sheets, keeping costume, accessories, body proportions, and overall style consistent on a unified neutral background suitable for character sheets.
gridMenu.frameProjection3sLaterPrompt: Project the state 3 seconds after this frame: continue character motion, expression, camera position, and environmental lighting naturally, while keeping character design and visual style consistent.
gridMenu.frameProjection5sEarlierPrompt: Reconstruct the state 5 seconds before this frame: infer the initiating actions, expressions, spatial relationships, and camera position, while keeping character design and visual style consistent.

mediaStorage.title: Image Host / Media Storage
mediaStorage.description: Configure the temporary reference media relay used by NewAPI/upstream models, with Aliyun OSS or Cloudinary.
mediaStorage.providerHint: With this provider we suggest leaving 「Fully-managed asset upload」 off; the free tier has a bandwidth quota, so use it only for point-to-point editing / uploads.
mediaStorage.warningIconLabel: Reference media storage is not configured
mediaStorage.notConfiguredImpact: O armazenamento de mídia de referência não está configurado. Fluxos somente de texto normalmente funcionam; recursos que enviam imagens locais exigem um provedor de armazenamento válido.
mediaStorage.fieldsHint: Saved values are stored in the local CE settings database; full AccessKeys are not returned. Leave saved credentials blank and enter only the fields you want to replace.
mediaStorage.cloudinaryFieldsHint: Saved values are stored in the local CE settings database; full API Key / Secret values are not returned. Leave saved credentials blank and enter only the fields you want to replace. API Folder is optional; leave it empty to upload to the Cloudinary root.

settings.pricingDesc: Manage node price display, exchange rate conversion, and credit-pack estimates.

settings.nanoBananaProModelDesc: Switch the Nano Banana Pro endpoint for this provider. If one endpoint fails, try another one. See the <modelListLink>model list</modelListLink> for details.
settings.radiusPresetDesc: Control global corner style for panels, inputs, and nodes.
settings.themeToneDesc: Choose neutral, warm, or cool tint for both light and dark themes.
settings.edgeRoutingModeDesc: Switch edge path style between nodes, including orthogonal routing with automatic node avoidance.
settings.accentColorDesc: Used by buttons, selected borders, and interaction highlights.
settings.downloadPresetPathsDesc: Used by node toolbar download menu for quick-save directories (up to 8).
settings.storyboardGenKeepStyleConsistent: Keep grid variants aligned with references
settings.storyboardGenKeepStyleConsistentDesc: Quando ativado, o prompt de variações mantém o estilo visual da imagem de referência.
settings.storyboardGenDisableTextInImage: Disallow descriptive text in grid variants
settings.storyboardGenDisableTextInImageDesc: Quando ativado, o prompt impede texto descritivo dentro da imagem.
settings.ignoreAtTagWhenCopyingAndGeneratingDesc: Quando ativado, textos copiados removem marcadores de referência antes da geração.
settings.useUploadFilenameAsNodeTitle: Use uploaded filename as node title
settings.useUploadFilenameAsNodeTitleDesc: When enabled, newly uploaded images use the file name as the node title by default (still editable via double-click).

settings.getApiKeyLink: click here to get API key

settings.autoCheckUpdateOnLaunchDesc: Check for updates once every time the app starts.
settings.enableUpdateDialogDesc: Show a custom dialog when a new version is detected.
settings.enableStoryboardGenGridPreviewShortcutDe: When enabled, holding Ctrl + Alt + Shift and clicking Generate on multi-variant grid creates a grid preview node without sending AI request.

settings.storyboardGenAutoInferEmptyFrameDesc: Quando ativado, células vazias usam o contexto anterior para orientar a geração.
settings.showNodePrice: Show node price in the header
settings.showNodePriceDesc: Continuously estimate the current run cost from the selected model, resolution, and extra options.
settings.priceDisplayCurrencyModeDesc: In auto mode, Chinese uses CNY and English uses USD.

settings.preferDiscountedPriceDesc: Currently this only applies to KIE. The discounted domestic pricing usually needs to be requested from KIE separately; when enabled, estimates prefer that discounted rate.
settings.grsaiCreditTierDesc: GRSAI bills in credits, so the per-run estimate changes with your top-up pack.
